tone: Handmade cabin timber; painted or raw, warm and hopeful — not grimdark.

BaseColor.notes: Warm plank. Painted instances shift hue; keep soft, not neon.

Roughness.notes: Painted boards lower roughness; raw boards higher.

Variation.notes: Grain + plank seams. UV-friendly for modular walls.

NightMix.notes: Slight cool wash; windows stay warm via separate emissive props/lights — never dark windows.

Emissive.notes: Cabin body off. Window panes / lantern glass use warm emissive instance or LIT, not dark glass.

allowed_instance_tweaks: Emissive on window/lantern glass instances only (warm)
cite_on_meshes: SM_Cabin_Wall / Roof / Chimney / Door / Window / PorchRail
